messages:
sasha: Heads up — planned rollout for tonight's change window (02:00 UTC). This touches runtime kernel patch, router routing switch, and a small console schema migration. Need pins + rollback playbook before we kick.
kevin: ack. which router variant are we planning to push? will it be compatible with old runtime KV layout?
maria: runtime patch is micro-eviction fix + kernel flag that changes batching heuristics. It should be backwards-compatible but we need to pin a router that doesn't rely on the new kv-evict header.
raj: runtime side: build 2026.03.17-kvfix. It introduces header X-KV-Evict-Version: v2. If router sees it it changes routing. We should gate by header flag.
olivia: console migration is a safe nullable column add (user_meta.v2). UI will read v2 if present. No forced writes on deploy.
kevin: propose sequence: 1) pin router to 3.2.0 (no header-aware behavior), 2) deploy runtime to 2026.03.17-kvfix behind feature flag, 3) run console schema add, 4) unpin router and flip header-aware router 3.2.1 can be rolled after monitoring window.
sasha: sounds good. Can we script the pin/unpin so deploybot does it? Want minimal human steps during the window.
maria: yes. deploybot has commands for slot pin/unpin. Example:
```
/deploy pin router service=router-prod version=3.2.0 reason="kv-evict safety"
/deploy deploy runtime service=runtime-prod version=2026.03.17-kvfix flag=kv_evict_safe
/deploy run-migration console add-column user_meta.v2 nullable
/deploy unpin router service=router-prod version=3.2.0
/deploy pin router service=router-prod version=3.2.1 reason="enable header-aware"
```
raj: rollback plan if we see evictions spike or latency > +30%: immediate runtime rollback to previous build + restore feature flag off. If router needs rollback, pin back to 3.2.0 and drain new instances.
olivia: console rollback is a no-op (nullable add). For safety we should not enable any writes to v2 until +24h stable.
kevin: Monitoring: set alert on eviction-rate, 95p latency on router, plus error-rate on console write APIs. If any alert fires escalate to @oncall.
sasha: agree. Who will be primary to execute pins and monitor? I can be lead for runtime and pins. Kevin takes router pin/unpin. Olivia will guard console migration.
kevin: I'll queue the pin/unpin commands and add runbook steps in the release notes.
deploybot: deploybot: scheduled change window: 02:00 UTC. To confirm run:
```
/deploy confirm window=02:00-03:00 tags=release-2026-03-17
```
raj: quick note — add automated KV telemetry check post-deploy: `kv.eviction_count` per-pod and `kv.hit_ratio` trending. If eviction_count > 50/min for any shard -> rollback.
sasha: added that to the runbook.
maria: preflight checklist:
- pin router 3.2.0 ✅
- smoke deploy runtime to canary cluster ✅
- run kv telemetry on canary for 30m ✅
- schema migration dry-run on staging ✅
- deploybot confirm window ✅
kevin: timeline during window:
- T+0: pin router
- T+5: deploy runtime to canary / small percent
- T+20: promote runtime to prod if canary OK
- T+30: run console migration
- T+60: unpin router and promote router 3.2.1
- T+90: post-mortem notes
sasha: rollback decision thresholds (finalized):
- eviction_count > 50/min on any shard OR
- router 95p latency +30% over baseline for >10m OR
- console write error rate > 1% for >5m
If any of these trigger: immediate runtime feature-flag off + runtime rollback and re-pin router 3.2.0. Notify #incidents and start hot-handoff.
kevin: I'll make the deploybot sequence and include an automated re-pin action if healthchecks fail.
deploybot: deploybot: created release ticket RH-2026-1354 and scheduled pinned steps. Automated re-pin task added to rollback handler.
oncall-bot: oncall-bot: Note: paging policy will escalate to oncall after 2m sustained alert. Contact list: sasha, kevin, raj, olivia.
sasha: last check — any outstanding dependencies from partners (dedicated infra / routing team)?
maria: routing infra team asked to keep a window of 10% capacity cushion. I've asked SLO team to reserve.
kevin: good. I'll push release notes with the exact commands and add the deploybot confirm snippet. Everyone OK to proceed?
raj: +1
olivia: +1
maria: +1
sasha: +1 — proceeding to pin in preflight and will post `/deploy confirm` once ready. :thumbsup:
